svg.text: Issue 238 | Flush Z16.2 bay cover — INFEASIBLE with current Main GH plugs
Top view: native case silhouette and #232 deck outlines. Blue outline is a study proposal, not fabrication geometry.
Grey: retained Wing decks/rim silhouette (17 mm); purple line: 16 mm cover boundary.
Cover/rim seam 0.20 mm nominal; top step 0.00 at Z16.20. USB keepout remains open at nose.
Cover would need its own internal supports: existing inner deck edges have no shared cover ledge.
Two hidden edge catches plus captive underside M2 screws are a concept only; no support layout is qualified.
• GH housings top Z18.50; R5/OD1 exit turn reaches at least Z24.00.
• Retained rack top Z22.20; uniform 1.5 mm roof also hits Fly shell (Z14.90) and tray material.
• Large empty volume does not remove the mandatory upward exit at J2/J3.
Fly 170 mm candidate: blue lower / green upper.
R5; Ø2 envelope. Measured collisions in JSON.
Main top Z11.2 / underside Z10 / floor Z2
All XY in mm; north up, positive Y south.
